real_qa.q: Why did the Nasdaq fall 5.5% on the day the stock market lost $2 trillion, and what stocks drove the decline?
real_qa.r: The Nasdaq fell 5.5% driven by a massive unwinding of the AI trade. Chipmaker and AI-related stocks that had been propelling the market higher suddenly dragged it down: NVIDIA fell 9%, Broadcom fell 10%, Qualcomm dropped 13%, Tesla and SpaceX both had nearly 10% wipeouts, and companies like CoreWeave, Nebius, and IRON fell more than 15% each.

real_qa.q: How many data center proposals passed in Tuesday's elections, and what does that signal about AI infrastructure expansion?
real_qa.r: Of the 45 data center related proposals on ballots across the country on Tuesday, 44 landed on the anti-data center side, with only one passing in Harwood, North Dakota with just 800 people. This represents a major setback because more than 40 percent of all planned data center capacity is slated to come online in Texas, Georgia, and Ohio—all states where newly elected governors are antagonistic to data centers.
